Every dot is an armed conflict event recorded by the Uppsala Conflict Data Program (UCDP): red when at least one civilian was killed, yellow when only armed actors died, and larger when the number of deaths is higher. The animation runs month by month from January 2000 and loops at the end. Past events slowly fade out, so the bright areas are the places where violence is ongoing.

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Load the gzipped UCDP extract (3 MB) and decompress it in the browser, so the
// data are not inlined in the page (which would make it ~20 MB).
dataset = {
  const url = await FileAttachment("../../data/ucdp/ged_events_2000_2025.csv.gz").url();
  const response = await fetch(url);
  const stream = response.body.pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream("gzip"));
  const text = await new Response(stream).text();
  const parseDate = d3.timeParse("%Y-%m-%d");
  return d3.csvParse(text, d => {
    const date = parseDate(d.date_start.slice(0, 10));
    const latitude = +d.latitude, longitude = +d.longitude;
    if (!date || isNaN(latitude) || isNaN(longitude)) return null;
    return {
      latitude, longitude, date,
      intensity: (+d.deaths_a) + (+d.deaths_b) + (+d.deaths_civilians),
      deaths_civilians: +d.deaths_civilians
    };
  }).sort((a, b) => a.date - b.date);
}
```


```{ojs}
// --- Data & parameters ---
world = d3.json("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/world-atlas@2/countries-110m.json")
countries = topojson.feature(world, world.objects.countries)

fade_opacity = 0.03
play_speed = 0.5

// --- Canvas + SVG dual-layer setup ---
viewof ctx = {
  const height = width / 1.8;
  const container = html`<div style="position:relative; width:${width}px; height:${height}px; background-color:#111; border-radius: 8px; overflow:hidden;"></div>`;

  // SVG layer (static: map, labels, legend)
  const svg = d3.select(container).append("svg")
    .attr("width", width)
    .attr("height", height)
    .style("position", "absolute")
    .style("top", "0px")
    .style("left", "0px");

  const dateLabel = svg.append("text")
    .attr("x", 20)
    .attr("y", 60)
    .attr("fill", "#ffffff")
    .style("font-family", "monospace")
    .style("font-size", "48px")
    .style("font-weight", "bold")
    .style("opacity", 0.5)
    .text("2000");

  // Legend (top right)
  const legend = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${width - 220}, 20)`);
  legend.append("circle").attr("cx", 8).attr("cy", 8).attr("r", 6).attr("fill", "#ff4040").attr("opacity", 0.85);
  legend.append("text").attr("x", 22).attr("y", 13)
    .attr("fill", "#cccccc").style("font-family", "monospace").style("font-size", "13px")
    .text("Civilian deaths");
  legend.append("circle").attr("cx", 8).attr("cy", 34).attr("r", 6).attr("fill", "#d2ff00").attr("opacity", 0.85);
  legend.append("text").attr("x", 22).attr("y", 39)
    .attr("fill", "#cccccc").style("font-family", "monospace").style("font-size", "13px")
    .text("Armed actors deaths");

  // Source credit (bottom left)
  svg.append("text")
    .attr("x", 20)
    .attr("y", height - 16)
    .attr("fill", "#888888")
    .style("font-family", "monospace")
    .style("font-size", "11px")
    .text("Source: UCDP Georeferenced Event Dataset (GED) v25.1 — Uppsala University");

  // World map
  const proj = d3.geoNaturalEarth1().fitSize([width, height], countries);
  const pathGenerator = d3.geoPath(proj);
  svg.append("path")
    .datum(countries)
    .attr("d", pathGenerator)
    .attr("fill", "#262626")
    .attr("stroke", "#444444")
    .attr("stroke-width", 0.5);

  // Canvas layer (dynamic: particles)
  const canvas = d3.select(container).append("canvas")
    .attr("width", width)
    .attr("height", height)
    .style("position", "absolute")
    .style("top", "0px")
    .style("left", "0px")
    .style("pointer-events", "none")
    .style("mix-blend-mode", "screen");

  const context2d = canvas.node().getContext("2d");
  context2d.projection = proj;
  context2d.dateLabel = dateLabel;
  container.value = context2d;

  return container;
}
```

```{ojs}
// --- Animation loop ---
animation = {
  const w = ctx.canvas.width;
  const h = ctx.canvas.height;
  const DAY_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

  const data = dataset.map(d => ({ ...d, time: d.date.getTime() }));
  const timeStart = d3.min(data, d => d.time);
  const timeEnd   = d3.max(data, d => d.time);

  let currentTime = timeStart;

  const t = d3.timer(() => {
    // Ghost trail: semi-transparent black overlay
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0, 0, 0, ${fade_opacity})`;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

    // Draw events in additive (glow) mode
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';
    const nextTime = currentTime + DAY_MS * play_speed;
    const activeEvents = data.filter(d => d.time >= currentTime && d.time < nextTime);

    for (const event of activeEvents) {
      const coords = ctx.projection([event.longitude, event.latitude]);
      if (coords) {
        const radius = Math.max(1, Math.min(Math.pow(event.intensity + 1, 0.35) * 1.5, 14));
        const color = event.deaths_civilians > 0 ? `rgba(255, 64, 64, 0.85)` : `rgba(210, 255, 0, 0.80)`;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.fillStyle = color;
        ctx.arc(coords[0], coords[1], radius, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }

    // Update date label
    const d = new Date(currentTime);
    ctx.dateLabel.text(`${d.getFullYear()} - ${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`);

    // Advance time; reset canvas at loop end
    currentTime = nextTime;
    if (currentTime > timeEnd) {
      currentTime = timeStart;
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
      ctx.fillStyle = "black";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
    }
  });

  return () => t.stop();
}
```
